description: Astra1_CS: regras nativas para descoberta, swipe aleatorio, undo/restart e chat simulado; DTOs publicos e dados privados. Sem publicacao ou carga de dados.

ops.value: "Neigh! Busy munching hay. Tell me more about those carrots."

actions.name: Context_Require
actions.description: Resolve o usuario no servidor; serializa escritas por perfil quando solicitado.

steps.where: DiscoveryRound.Id = LongIntegerToIdentifier(RoundId) and DiscoveryRound.DemoProfileId = ProfileId and DiscoveryRound.ClosedOn = NullDate()

then.message: "Rodada inválida ou encerrada. Atualize a descoberta."

steps.if: Filters.AgeMin < 3 or Filters.AgeMax > 25 or Filters.AgeMin > Filters.AgeMax
Filters.HeightMinInches < 52 or Filters.HeightMaxInches > 72 or Filters.HeightMinInches > Filters.HeightMaxInches

actions.name: Candidates_Query
actions.description: Predicado unico para listagem, contador e validacao do swipe; SQL parametrizado com exclusao de historico e matches ativos.

steps.statement:
SELECT {Horse}.* FROM {Horse} WHERE {Horse}.[IsActive] = 1 AND {Horse}.[Id] <> @ActorId
AND (@TargetId = 0 OR {Horse}.[Id] = @TargetId)
AND (@SexId = 0 OR {Horse}.[SexId] = @SexId)
AND (@BreedId = 0 OR {Horse}.[BreedId] = @BreedId)
AND (@DisciplineId = 0 OR {Horse}.[DisciplineId] = @DisciplineId)
AND {Horse}.[AgeYears] BETWEEN @AgeMin AND @AgeMax
AND {Horse}.[HeightInInches] BETWEEN @HeightMin AND @HeightMax
AND (@StudbookOnly = 0 OR {Horse}.[IsStudbookVerified] = 1)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {SwipeDecision} WHERE {SwipeDecision}.[DemoProfileId] = @ProfileId AND {SwipeDecision}.[RoundId] = @RoundId AND {SwipeDecision}.[TargetHorseId] = {Horse}.[Id] AND {SwipeDecision}.[UndoneOn] = @NullDate)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {HorseMatch} WHERE {HorseMatch}.[DemoProfileId] = @ProfileId AND {HorseMatch}.[TargetHorseId] = {Horse}.[Id] AND {HorseMatch}.[MatchStatusId] = @ActiveStatus) ORDER BY {Horse}.[DisplayOrder], {Horse}.[Id] OFFSET @Start ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM {Horse} WHERE {Horse}.[IsActive] = 1 AND {Horse}.[Id] <> @ActorId
AND (@TargetId = 0 OR {Horse}.[Id] = @TargetId)
AND (@SexId = 0 OR {Horse}.[SexId] = @SexId)
AND (@BreedId = 0 OR {Horse}.[BreedId] = @BreedId)
AND (@DisciplineId = 0 OR {Horse}.[DisciplineId] = @DisciplineId)
AND {Horse}.[AgeYears] BETWEEN @AgeMin AND @AgeMax
AND {Horse}.[HeightInInches] BETWEEN @HeightMin AND @HeightMax
AND (@StudbookOnly = 0 OR {Horse}.[IsStudbookVerified] = 1)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {SwipeDecision} WHERE {SwipeDecision}.[DemoProfileId] = @ProfileId AND {SwipeDecision}.[RoundId] = @RoundId AND {SwipeDecision}.[TargetHorseId] = {Horse}.[Id] AND {SwipeDecision}.[UndoneOn] = @NullDate)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {HorseMatch} WHERE {HorseMatch}.[DemoProfileId] = @ProfileId AND {HorseMatch}.[TargetHorseId] = {Horse}.[Id] AND {HorseMatch}.[MatchStatusId] = @ActiveStatus)

actions.name: Discovery_Initialize
actions.description: Inicializa contexto autenticado, filtros e rodada. Requer catalogo previamente carregado; nao popula dados.

then.message: "Catálogo demo não carregado: falta Hayden (SeedCode hayden)."

actions.name: Discovery_SavePreferences
actions.description: Persiste filtros validados sem apagar historico da rodada.

actions.name: Discovery_GetCandidates
actions.description: Consulta paginada, sem binarios de foto, com filtros e exclusao de decisoes/matches ativos.

steps.where: HorseMatch.Id = LongIntegerToIdentifier(MatchId) and HorseMatch.DemoProfileId = ProfileId and HorseMatch.MatchStatusId = Entities.MatchStatus.Active

actions.name: Swipe_Submit
actions.description: Like sorteia uma vez no servidor (0-99); Pass nunca sorteia. Resultado congelado por request e por cavalo/rodada; perfil bloqueado durante a transacao.

then.message: "Candidato indisponível nesta rodada ou fora dos filtros."

then.where: SwipeDecision.DemoProfileId = Context.Profile.Id and SwipeDecision.RoundId = LongIntegerToIdentifier(RoundId) and SwipeDecision.TargetHorseId = LongIntegerToIdentifier(HorseId) and SwipeDecision.HasDraw

actions.name: Receipt_Read
actions.description: Undo/restart usam a chave canonica RoundId no campo legado PayloadHash (sem digest); compara conteudo antes de devolver o recibo.

then.message: "RequestId já usado com outro comando ou rodada."

actions.name: Swipe_UndoLast
actions.description: Desfaz apenas a ultima decisao da rodada. Fecha match sem conversa; bloqueia reversao se ja houver mensagens.

steps.where: SwipeDecision.DemoProfileId = Context.Profile.Id and SwipeDecision.RoundId = LongIntegerToIdentifier(RoundId) and SwipeDecision.UndoneOn = NullDate()

then.message: "Não é possível desfazer um match que já possui mensagens."

actions.name: Discovery_Restart
actions.description: Nova rodada reapresenta passes e likes sem match; preserva matches ativos e conversas. Reenvio devolve a rodada original.

actions.name: Chat_GetMessages
actions.description: Pagina por Id crescente; somente conversa de um match ativo do usuario autenticado.

actions.name: Chat_SendMessage
actions.description: Envia texto e resposta generica na mesma transacao; idempotencia por match/request; nao chama IA nem integra mensageria real.

steps.where: Message.HorseMatchId = LongIntegerToIdentifier(MatchId) and Message.ClientRequestId = RequestId and Message.SenderTypeId = Entities.MessageSenderType.User
